title: Update Tower preferences for spear
objective: Record the user's project purpose and preferred lean Tower operating style so future Tower sessions resume with the right defaults.
instructions: Add durable Tower/project preference docs stating that spear is for building and setting up a simulator for active illumination research.
Record that Tower and Builder should operate lean: quick discussion, Builder implements, user runs the simulator to check.
Record that Inspector should almost never be sent by default; use only when the user asks for review/QA or a high-risk change warrants it.
Record that Scout is for research only during deep technical discussions, not routine implementation.
Record that Tower's main value in this project is memory/context savings and concise orchestration, not heavyweight multi-agent workflow.
Update appropriate .control-tower docs/state and/or memory-facing docs. Do not edit product source.
expected_outputs: Updated Tower docs/state reflecting project purpose and lean delegation preferences.
definition_of_done: A future Tower session can read the docs/state and know the project purpose plus default routing preferences.
